title: Jaisi Karni Waisi Bharni
desc: A man rejects his honest father's way of life and marries his enemy's daughter. His son decides to teach his parents a lesson.

title: Swarg Se Sunder
desc: A tale of love, faith, and divine intervention, where family bonds are challenged by misunderstandings and betrayal. In the end, compassion and truth bring about healing and unity.

title: Rakshak
desc: Demeaned all his life, Raghu decides to teach the world a lesson by printing the best ever fake currency notes.

title: Jamai Raja
desc: Siddharth, a hotelier, tries to mend the broken bond between his strong-willed wife, Roshni, and her ambitious mother, Durga Devi. His efforts lead to emotional twists and heartfelt moments.

title: Kaajal
desc: In Ranimaa's family, tragedy strikes after Rajesh marries Bhanu. Bhanu dislikes Madhavi, leading to her attempted suicide. Moti saves her and marries her, but he has secret plans for Madhavi.

title: Aatank
desc: People living in a coastal village come across black pearls in the ocean. Their greed to harvest the entire bounty proves deadly as the ocean is home to a man-eating shark.

title: Tumko Na Bhool Paayenge
desc: Veer is attacked by goons who identify him as Ali. To unravel the mystery of his past, he decides to go Mumbai.

title: Kachche Dhaage
desc: Estranged step bothers must come together to rescue the kidnapped mother of one of them.

title: Sainik
desc: When Lieutenant Suraj disappears, his father fears the worst but keeps it secret from his daughter and son's wife. However, they're already aware, putting on a brave face.

title: Pyar To Hona Hi Tha
desc: When a clumsy man meets a heartbroken woman, their accidental companionship leads to love, laughter, and life lessons, reshaping their destiny in the most unexpected way.

title: Beqabu
desc: Raja helps imprison a terrorist who then murders him. Years later, Raja's girlfriend comes across his lookalike in Nepal and decides to find the truth.

title: Khakee
desc: DCP Anant has been assigned the task to escort terrorist Iqbal Ansari from Chandangarh to Mumbai. Anant's team is armed but danger lurks everywhere.

title: Soldier
desc: A man arrives in Australia to avenge his father's death. While looking for his enemy, he falls for the daughter of a rich man.

title: Bhagam Bhag
desc: Champak, the owner of a theatre group, travels to London to organise a show along with Bunty and Babla, two of his group members. They soon find themselves embroiled in a murder they did not commit.
